findings.section: Repo: dogs-app, D-03 (and D-01/D-06 cross-listed tests)
findings.evidence: SPEC 2.5 step 8: named_tests.py requires every test named in this repo's PLAN section to exist in the dogs-app test tree and pass in the dogs-app tests-job JUnit. D-03 names test_structure_fails_on_empty_section, which the plan only creates in appsec-baseline (A-05/A-12 stage/tests). D-03's listed dogs-app test files (test_skill, test_final_pr_body, test_stage_log) do not obviously contain it. D-06 also names test_agents_match_spec_table, which lives in D-04's test_agents.py. That one is fine because the test runs from the directory.
findings.recommendation: At the code stage, make sure dogs-app tests/process has a test with that exact name (for example a template-structure check in test_skill.py that imports .appsec-baseline/stage/structure.py), or drop the name from D-03. The plan-drift rule lets the plan be updated in the same PR. This does not block the plan.
